test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct logical sequence.

A. These can turn around to track stars with the rotation of Earth.

B. Observatories are places to study place.

C. They are mostly built on the mountain tops.

D. Telescopes are placed in the dome-shaped roof of the building.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (1)** i.e. **BCDA**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with "**B"** Observatories are places to study place" which introduces the subject, observatories.
 
• Following it, "**C"** They are mostly built on the mountain tops" specifies the typical locations of these observatories.
 
• **"D"** Telescopes are placed in the dome-shaped roof of the building" describes an important feature of observatories.
 
• **"A"** These can turn around to track stars with the rotation of Earth" explains the functionality of the telescopes within observatories.

Therefore, the correct answer is **BCDA.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (DCBA):** This option starts with "Telescopes are placed in the dome-shaped roof of the building," which gives detailed information before introducing the main subject.
 
• **Option 3 (ACDB):** This option disrupts the logical flow by starting with a specific feature and functionality before setting the context.
 
• **Option 4 (CBDA):** This option mixes up the description of locations, specific features, and their functionality, making the sequence less coherent.
